prompt: Promote experiments/fanctl in my sandbox repo to its own repo at ~/Workspace/fanctl, keeping its history. It should not be in sandbox any longer.

steps: mkdir -p ~/Workspace/fanctl && cd ~/Workspace/fanctl && git init -q -b main && git pull -q ~/Workspace/sandbox fanctl-split
git rm -rq experiments/fanctl && git commit -qm 'Move fanctl to its own repo' && git branch -q -D fanctl-split
solution.answer: fanctl now lives in ~/Workspace/fanctl with its three commits; removed from sandbox.
